what_happened: After a two-reviewer design review, the person running Athena (with Sri's approval) queued four changes to Athena's improvement loop by hand. The changes are: a guaranteed turn for Athena's own fixes, stop-and-diagnose on repeated failures, a way to relax a rule, and a measure of wasted work. The review found that Loop B sees and diagnoses thrash (repeated failing or wasted attempts) but has no way to act on it. The person gave the design, not just the outcome. This was not a failed job.
cause: Athena has no design or critique stage that reviews its own improvement loop. Loop B was built to observe and diagnose but with no action path, and no check asks whether each diagnosed condition has a mechanism that can act on it. Design review of Athena's own process therefore happens only when a person arranges it. The design work then lands as hand-written instructions and not as something Athena derives.
prevention: Add a standing self-review stage that periodically runs a design review of Athena's loops. For each signal a loop detects, it checks that a defined action exists (act, escalate or relax) and that the action has a guaranteed turn in the queue. It then turns gaps into queued, outcome-stated requests with measurable acceptance, such as a wasted-work metric, so the person running Athena approves outcomes instead of writing designs.
proposed_request: Add a periodic self-review of Athena's improvement loops. For each condition a loop detects (such as repeated failures or thrash), it must check that a mechanism exists that acts on it. When none exists, queue a request that states the outcome. Cover four outcomes: (1) Athena's own fixes for its loops get a guaranteed turn in the queue; (2) repeated failures of the same kind stop the line and trigger a diagnosis before another retry; (3) a rule can be relaxed through a recorded, bounded override; (4) wasted work (attempts that produce nothing landed) is measured per period and shown. Acceptance: a replay over past jobs shows the review flags the Loop B gap, and each of the four outcomes has a test that shows the behavior, not only that the parts exist.
